notes.title: WARCANA Patch 4 is Out Now!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534244/8f1a7f49466c14f36e8d45132d877afbfe70d684.png

We're back with Patch 4 for WARCANA! But that's not all! We're happy to announce that the Single Player Demo is back!

This patch is focused on balancing the game based on player feedback, as well as fixing a number of bugs! 

Here's the TL;DR:

 The Single Player Demo is back, with 10 campaign missions to play through!
 Fine-tuned the Battle Royale turn timings
 Added 10 new prebuild decks
 All hand cards now get discarded at the end of the round
 Tons of balancing and bug fixes!

 
New Features and General Improvements
- New Unit: Lykonian Brood
- New Barracks: Breeding Pool
- Different cards that do the same actions now have the description text in the same order
- Add 10 new prebuild decks
- All hand cards now get discarded at the end of the round
- The system for increasing wall costs is now explained in the tutorial
- Fay Calling devotion description updated to remove false claim that units regenerate HP from faction perk

Balancing Changes
Battle Royale Changes
- Changed Turn Timings:
Turn 0 - Total: 70 - Peaceful: 50 - Battle: 20
Turn 1 - Total: 80 - Peaceful: 45 - Battle: 35
Turn 2 - Total: 90 - Peaceful: 40 - Battle: 50
Turn 3 - Total: 100 - Peaceful: 35 - Battle: 65
Turn 4 - Total: 110 - Peaceful: 30 - Battle: 80
Turn 5 - Total: 115 - Peaceful: 25 - Battle: 90
Turn 6 - Total: 120 - Peaceful: 20 - Battle: 100
Turn 7 - Total: 130 - Peaceful: 20 - Battle: 110
Turn 8 - Total: 140 - Peaceful: 20 - Battle: 120
Turn 9 - Total: 150 - Peaceful: 20 - Battle: 130
Turn 10 - Total: 160 - Peaceful: 20 - Battle: 140

Card Changes
- Binding Tentacles Card: Cost 2 Mana -> 4 Mana
- Crystal Crush Card: Cost 2 Mana -> 3 Mana
- Poison Storm Card: Cost 2 Mana -> 4 Mana
- Chalice of Faith: Gain 30 Structure and 2 Mana -> 10 Structure and 1 Mana
- Chalice of Faith: Cost 45 Structure -> 30 Structure
- Old Wisdom Card: Cost 45 Structure -> 10 Structure
- Old Wisdom Card: Gain 3 Mana -> 4 Mana
- Unholy Pact Card: Added Gain 6 Mana
- Sharpen Card: Add gain 90 Structure
- Sacrifice Card: Cost 2 Mana -> 20 Structure
- Sacrifice Card: Add gain 4 Mana
- Oppressed Court Card: Cost 55 Structure -> 30 Structure
- Sacred Altar Card: Cost 55 Structure -> 30 Structure
- Leviathan Card: Cost 7 Mana -> 11 Mana
- Great Calamity Card: Cost 4 Mana -> 9 Mana
- Negotiator Alpha Card: Cost 4 Mana -> 9 Mana
- Negotiator Beta Card: Cost 5 Mana -> 10 Mana
- Celestial Avatar Card: Cost 5 Mana -> 10 Mana
- Star Eater Card: 7 Mana -> 11 Mana
- Summer Card: Structure gain 80 -> Structure gain 70
- Entropy Temple Card: On survive gain 20 Structure -> On survive gain 25 Structure
- Kelp Picking Card: gain 40 Structure -> gain 50 Structure
- Kelp Picking Card: Cost 3 Mana -> 2 Mana
- Feeding Time Card: Cost 20 Structure -> 0 Structure
- Crush Card: Structure gain 60 -> 65
- Starry Night Card: Cost 35 Structure -> 80 Structure
- Infinity Channel: Provide Starry Night on survive -> Provide Starry Night on first survive
- Thermal Uplift Card: Cost 3 Mana -> 6 Mana
- Espionage Card: Cost 2 Mana -> 4 Mana

- Thermal Uplift Card: Card Structure gain 90 -> 45
- Luminous Reef Card: Provide Thermal Uplift on survive
- Underwater Spring Card: Provide Turn the Tide on survive -> Prove Thermal Uplift on first survive
- Aqueduct Card: Provide Turn the Tide on First Survive (Single Use) -> Provide Turn the Tide on First Survive (Permanent)
- Uproot Card: Cost 0 Mana -> Cost 20 Structure
- Grow Strong Card: Structure gain 90 -> 70
- Reconfigure Card: Single use -> Permanent
- Deer Grove Card: Provide Moonlight Deer on build -> Provide Moonlight Deer on first survive
- Convergence Card: Cost 5 Mana -> 7 Mana

Unit Changes
- Negotiator Alpha Card: Wall Damage 65 -> 70
- Negotiator Alpha Card: Tower Damage 34 -> 50
- Negotiator Beta Card: Wall Damage 65 -> 70
- Negotiator Beta Card: Tower Damage 34 -> 50
- Scavengers Card: Unit area 30 -> 20
- Sniper Alpha Card: Range 5 -> Range 7
- High Priest Card: Unit spawns 500 -> 1000
- High Priest Card: Wall Damage 9/s -> 14/s

Tower Changes
- Seismic Disruptor Card: Idle number of attacks 1 -> 3
- Seismic Disruptor Card: Attack area modified
- Seismic Disruptor Card: Idle time 14 -> 30

Autospawn Changes
- Jellyfish Origin: On survive spawn 150 Jellyfish Spawn -> On Survive Spawn 750 Jellyfish Swarm

- Veiled Lair: On survive spawn 200 Spiderlings -> On Survive Spawn 500 Spiderlings

- Pressing Matter: On survive spawn 200 Harbinger -> On Survive Spawn 500 Harbinger
- Endless Depth: Nothing -> On Survive Spawn 500 Scavengers
- Sand Gills: Nothing -> On Survive Spawn 250 Towering Presence

- Turn the Tide Ability: Shuffle Discard into Deck -> Removed

- Thermal Uplift Ability: Add Shuffle Discard into deck

Scenario Changes
- Life and Death: Added 7 Crystal Labs on Player Island
- Burial: Adjusted Artillery placement

Fixed Issues
- Fixed post-game screen displaying wrong player rank at the top
- Fixed a typo in the French localisation for Economy buildings
- Fixed 'single use' text showing outside the draw/discard pile while scrolling
- Updated the rank overview screen in the profile with correct division names for alternate ranks
- Players can no longer go up or down more than one rank in a single game
- Replays now correctly play back the game after a player disconnects
- It is no longer possible to remove cards in deckbuilding screen while the devotion overview is open
- Fixed building range not displaying when hovering over a building while paused
- It is no longer possible to watch replays while in the multiplayer queue
- The tech tree can no longer be scrolled from outside the window
- Unit tooltips no longer flicker when the game is paused, and are now hidden
- Card will no longer be highlighted in the main menu after leaving a campaign mission with a highlighted card
- Fixed a rare bug where cards would get stuck on the hand after being played

Please note: Due to these changes, old replays are now incompatible.

Please continue to send us over your feedback and thoughts as you play through the new patch!

notes.title: WARCANA Patch 3 is Out Now!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534244/cd56d443038998f437f5bebe5bb875ef64dd3644.png

Hello again!
 
We're back with our third post-launch patch for WARCANA!

Once again, thank you for all of your feedback! We hope that this series of patches has made the game a lot more enjoyable for you!

Here's the TL;DR for this patch:

 Main Building is immune to Attack Spells!
 New controls for power players!
 Pause Button in Single Player
 Bigger Smite with charges
 Wall balancing
 Devotion balancing changes
 Small campaign improvements
 Lots of bug fixes

 
New Features:
Interface-Setting:
- “Set card animation speed” option added
Controls:
- Use keys 1,2,3,4 for Card/Building choice picks
- Use keys Q & E to switch between islands
- Use Spacebar to pause/unpause in single player
- Smite is now bound to Ctrl
 
General Improvements
UI:
- Cards now display the string "Single use" if they are single use cards
- Pause button in the top menu now works in Single Player. Hold it to fast-forward
- Improved visual feedback when selecting a building variant or making a card choice

General Balancing
Main Building
- Is now immune to Attack Spells!
Smite
- Charges: every 3s -> 2x round number,
- Hotkey: Space -> Ctrl L & R,
- Size: 2x2 -> 5x5
Walls
- Starting at 200 Walls: Wall cost increases by 1, increases further for each 100 additional Walls

Devotion Balancing
Occultism
Crystal Crush:
- Card cost: 1 Mana -> 2 Mana
Noble Demon:
- Wall damage 5 -> 2
- Health: 25 -> 15

Fay Calling
Forest Biotope:
- Card cost: 40 Structure -> 25 Structure
Ancient Warden:
- Attack Damage: 32/s -> 26/s

Current Weaving
Mana Cistern:
- Building-variant: Provides From the Deep on First Survive -> Provides From the Deep on Survive
From the Deep:
- Card: Permanent -> Single Use
- Card cost: 2 -> 3 Mana
Spectral Stream: 
- provides Binding Tencales on first survive -> on survive
Binding Tentacles:
- Card: Pemanent -> Single use
Underwater Spring: 
- provide Turn the Tide on first survive -> on survive
Treasure Vault: 
- provide Storm Tide on first survive -> on survive
Storm Tide:
- Card: Pemanent -> Single use
Permanent Turn the Tide:
- Card: Shuffle Discard pile back was removed

Technomancy
Technomancy Perk Trait:
- Technomancy Health gain per round: 10hp ->25hp
BLASTER Alpha & Beta:
- Wall Damage: 6/s -> 12/s
BREACHER Alpha & Beta:
- Health: 100 -> 220
- Speed: 100px/s -> 130px/s
Annihilator:
- Explosion impact area: 150 pixels -> 220 pixels

Void Forging
Black Hole:
- Duration: 3s -> 6s

Campaign Improvements
- Campaign messages can be closed with Space, Return and Esc as well!
- Arrival (Tutorial)
- Flow improved
- Text changes
- Swarm intelligence in single player missions adjusted to work with balance changes

Fixed Issues
- Main Building health bars now update immediately
- Attack Spells and Tower Lasers no longer remain after someone has died
- Flying card animations no longer block input
- Auto spawns triggered by buildings now always appear in the spawn list
- Card destruction effects are now only played for cards visible on screen
- Camera can now be moved with WASD, even when hovering over UI or Cards
- Improved German translation of the Arrival (Tutorial)
- F2 no longer accelerates animations in Multiplayer matches
- The game no longer crashes when trying to build more than 4096 buildings/walls. Once 4000 buildings have been placed, building walls is disabled. Once 4096 buildings have been placed, no more buildings can be built.
- Fixed wall segments not being built at exactly maximum length
- Fixed a crash when continuing a save from the “A Free Meal” DLC scenario
- Placed the spell preview grid on the same height as spell outlines
- Added missing translation for the ‘locked’ campaign button
- Fixed a bug where the attack patterns of towers were inverted

Please note: Due to these changes, old replays are now incompatible.

Please continue to send us over your feedback and thoughts as you play through the new patch!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2022930/WARCANA/

notes.title: New WARCANA Release Date - 29th August
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534244/3ffab6343cd935cdddc023f3e52a5833d6dededc.png

How’s it going everyone?

We’ve got some important (and maybe slightly disappointing) news to share with you today. WARCANA’s original launch date was set to be the 15th August, however following the demo and player feedback, we’ve decided to push the launch date back by a couple of weeks to 29th August.

The main reason for this slight delay is that we’re upgrading to dedicated online servers instead of the peer-to-peer connections we were using in the demo. This will increase WARCANA’s network reliability and improve the online game experience for you all, but it does take time to get there.

At the end of the day, we want our players to have a good multiplayer experience at launch and don’t want network issues to get in the way!

We know this will be disappointing news, but we look forward to meeting you all on the battlefield on 29th August!

- The 1000 Orks Team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2022930/WARCANA/

notes.title: Check out our brand new WARCANA announcement trailer!
notes.content:
WARCANA is a fantasy-inspired, base defence, RTS game with a deck-building mechanic. Face hundreds of thousands of unrelenting monsters all at once in a battle royale between 30 other mighty magicians. Build your deck. Prepare your ​defences​. Summon your armies. Survive the onslaught. Can you be the last one standing? 

See the trailer here 👇🏼

[previewyoutube=EK1RABjUCBY;full][/previewyoutube]

Base Defence & Deck Building Entwined

Your base is your deck... and your deck is your base. Construct wisely to unlock and build your deck with powerful cards to help you turn the tide of battle. Mighty towers, ferocious monsters and destructive spells are at your command — if you play your cards right.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32941731/8128bf4ed5234ba4cee1546d1f7f10d579c8be5a.png

Round-based Battle Royale

30 players compete to be the last one standing in a fantasy dimension of pure magic. Each round begins with a calm phase of planning, strategizing and building, followed by an action-packed battle to break through defences and destroy an ​opponent's​ base. Culminating in a ​climactic​ finish, a sudden wave of pure magic will wash over the battlefield, annihilating all units and reviving fallen buildings. As long as your base survives, your other buildings are returned to their former glory and you go again in the next round. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32941731/0510372795b6ed3f1141399d220fdeaa119366f0.png

Epic Battles of Massive Proportions

Summon hundreds of thousands of units to your army as a maelstrom of monsters simultaneously causes extensive destruction to your own defences. Walls will crumble and towers will fall during the onslaught. Keep the horde at bay as you attempt to break through to your ​opponent's​ base.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32941731/2af058517e4a7e12ada17efc10f210ff32a3eb00.png

Five Unique Factions

Will you survive against the mystical forces of ‘Life‘? Will you spread demonic dread as a champion of the ‘Occult‘? Choose between - and ​battle​ against - five ​fantastical​ factions, each with their own distinctive buildings, units and spells. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32941731/8360f2fba60205583200940846ea9921b888fcfd.png

Single-Player Campaign & Custom Modes

Play at your own pace offline with hours of single-player scenarios and handcrafted challenges to tackle, or create and share your own via the in-game editor. Confront Horde Mode and compete against others to be the first to defeat one million units or participate in a unique social experience with your favourite streamer and communities in the Stream Sniper game mode... Whatever your preference, prepare for mayhem and guaranteed destruction!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32941731/9a07943afa0691a427e985c695669201b7247403.png
 
Features

 Beautiful Pixel Art
 Unique Genre Mix
 Epic Battles With Up To 30 Players 
 Single-Player Campaign
 Five Unique Playable Factions
 Hundreds of Thousands of Units On-Screen
 Custom & Steam Sniper Mode

notes.title: Team17 form an arcane alliance with 1000 Orks to debut Warcana
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32941731/1093e0ec0626566f2483d591884e5a6c0679142d.png

WARCANA is a fantasy-inspired, base defence, RTS game with a deck-building mechanic. Face hundreds of thousands of unrelenting monsters all at once in a battle royale between 30 other mighty magicians. Build your deck. Prepare your ​defences​. Summon your armies. Survive the onslaught. Can you be the last one standing? 

Base Defence & Deck Building Entwined

Your base is your deck... and your deck is your base. Construct wisely to unlock and build your deck with powerful cards to help you turn the tide of battle. Mighty towers, ferocious monsters and destructive spells are at your command — if you play your cards right.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32941731/8128bf4ed5234ba4cee1546d1f7f10d579c8be5a.png

Round-based Battle Royale

30 players compete to be the last one standing in a fantasy dimension of pure magic. Each round begins with a calm phase of planning, strategizing and building, followed by an action-packed battle to break through defences and destroy an ​opponent's​ base. Culminating in a ​climactic​ finish, a sudden wave of pure magic will wash over the battlefield, annihilating all units and reviving fallen buildings. As long as your base survives, your other buildings are returned to their former glory and you go again in the next round. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32941731/0510372795b6ed3f1141399d220fdeaa119366f0.png

Epic Battles of Massive Proportions

Summon hundreds of thousands of units to your army as a maelstrom of monsters simultaneously causes extensive destruction to your own defences. Walls will crumble and towers will fall during the onslaught. Keep the horde at bay as you attempt to break through to your ​opponent's​ base.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32941731/2af058517e4a7e12ada17efc10f210ff32a3eb00.png

Five Unique Factions

Will you survive against the mystical forces of ‘Life‘? Will you spread demonic dread as a champion of the ‘Occult‘? Choose between - and ​battle​ against - five ​fantastical​ factions, each with their own distinctive buildings, units and spells. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32941731/8360f2fba60205583200940846ea9921b888fcfd.png

Single-Player Campaign & Custom Modes

Play at your own pace offline with hours of single-player scenarios and handcrafted challenges to tackle, or create and share your own via the in-game editor. Confront Horde Mode and compete against others to be the first to defeat one million units or participate in a unique social experience with your favourite streamer and communities in the Stream Sniper game mode... Whatever your preference, prepare for mayhem and guaranteed destruction!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32941731/9a07943afa0691a427e985c695669201b7247403.png
 
Features

 Beautiful Pixel Art
 Unique Genre Mix
 Epic Battles With Up To 30 Players 
 Single-Player Campaign
 Five Unique Playable Factions
 Hundreds of Thousands of Units On-Screen
 Custom & Steam Sniper Mode
To join the community and keep up to date on WARCANA, please like us on Facebook, and follow us on Twitter.
